name: ArtiSys QA
boundary: Reusable QA platform for web/Electron products with declarative flows, execution profiles, desktop smoke checks, network/concurrency helpers, reusable business packs, evidence capture, reports/history, fail-closed release gates, fail-safe CI summaries for shared consumers, bounded per-file module validation with live output, dependency-hydrated shared CI verification, optional self-hosted Remote Control, a Windows local agent with logon startup and stable A/B auto-update, an outbound private-repository bridge for whitelisted QA jobs, deterministic Google Drive artifact storage, managed consumer repositories, durable live agent telemetry, an authenticated read-only LAN observability console, and optional best-effort Cloudflare D1/R2 observability mirroring. Product-specific persistence, schema mapping, credentials, selectors and installer behavior remain isolated behind consumer configuration/adapters.

compatibility.driveUploader: rclone + user-authorized Google Drive OAuth desktop client
compatibility.managedProjects: Git repositories under nutricionistaalmeidavh-spec with optional whitelisted npm-ci/npm-install/dotnet-restore/pip-requirements setup
compatibility.lanConsole: Same local network; TCP 4160 by default; explicit LAN enable + bearer token
compatibility.cloudObservability: Optional Cloudflare Worker with D1 binding DB and R2 binding R2; separate agent and reader secrets

limitations: Product-specific persistence, fixture schema mapping, UI capabilities and installer behavior are implemented by each consumer adapter/configuration.
Desktop smoke checks require the executable to exist on the runner operating system.
Managed repositories must be explicitly listed in the private control registry; the agent never clones an arbitrary repository supplied by a QA job.
A repository without an ArtiSys QA config must receive that config in GitHub before the managed agent can register it automatically.
Private repository auto-update, bridge polling and managed project sync require Git authentication already configured on the Windows machine; the agent does not store a GitHub token.
Google Drive upload is disabled until a local rclone Drive remote is explicitly authorized; Google OAuth client secrets/tokens are not stored in the ArtiSys QA state.
Visual regression is disabled by default and only runs with --visual or ARTISYS_QA_VISUAL=1.
Remote Control and the repository bridge accept only declared/whitelisted QA operations and do not accept arbitrary shell commands.
The agent-level LAN console is read-only and is loopback-only until explicitly enabled for LAN access.
Cloudflare D1/R2 mirroring is optional, best-effort and disabled until the Worker URL and local agent token are configured.
The Cloudflare reader secret is never stored by the Windows agent; it is entered only in the remote dashboard when needed.
The runner machine must remain powered on for Remote Control, project sync, bridge executions and the LAN console.
Local-only systems require a compatible local runner for OS-specific executable and installer checks.
